gate_order: Fresh strict GCC14 C11 source build
Decisive reversed dynamic vec4 clamp plus unsigned product-overflow dot actual target execution
All frozen semantic/target cases with all negative output modes
Isolated exact/one-short pools and actual target ID/word ledgers
Public ABI consumers, no allocation/export drift, fenv/MXCSR/errno and sanitizer failures
Source-bound M11/M10/historical regressions with exact per-source new admission mappings
Unchanged exact98 source recompile, validate, execute and remaining secondary blockers
Complete stack/path proof, source identity recheck and truthful receipt
historical_policy: Materialize retained source through existing source-bound prepare_retained.py; do not duplicate corpora or alter original tests/receipts. Name each newly admitted negative individually. Exact98 baseline 52 validated/43 executed/9 validation-only/46 rejected. No assumed +17 admission.
independent_case_policy: Exact source bytes and mathematical expectations freeze before implementation. Retain every first failure. Any evaluator correction needs separate old/new evidence, not broad weakened negatives.
mutations: checked AI product contrary to N1
reload prior argument after later effect
one target ID or word undercount
native_obligations: no library allocation or mutable global
strict FP flags and rounding/traps/exceptions/MXCSR/errno restored on every new error exit
complete individual frames, recursive SCCs and combined call-path bounds
